phrase_families: PL1_RECIPROCAL_CENSORSHIP: Western platform blocks Russian media first -> Russian restriction framed as response/reciprocity.
PL2_GGC_INFRASTRUCTURE_EXCULPATION: Google left/reduced support -> GGC not maintained/expanded -> YouTube degradation attributed to Google infrastructure.
PL3_PLATFORM_SELF_BLOCKING: access/information loss attributed to Western platform/search-engine filtering or a Western-agenda frame.
PL4_TWO_SIDED_IRON_CURTAIN: Russian state blocking + real Western geoblocking -> isolation framed as mutual/two-sided.
PL5_GOOGLE_LEFT_BY_ITSELF: service loss framed as consequence of foreign-company voluntary exit rather than domestic policy/control.
phrase_lineage_epistemic_firewall: Exact quotation/syndication of an official or news source is SOURCE_PROPAGATION, not coordination evidence by itself.
Near-exact independent restatement preserving rare technical tokens and argument order is a stronger message-propagation signal but still not operator attribution.
Real GGC degradation, Western geoblocking, sanctions effects and actual platform moderation remain mandatory negative controls.
Do not label ordinary public users bots or state assets from text similarity alone.
reddit_negative_controls: Reddit contained strong technical rebuttals identifying RKN/DPI and provider heterogeneity during the 2024 YouTube slowdown.
Western platforms genuinely restricted Russian state-media content after the 2022 invasion; this factual core cannot be treated as fabricated.
Foreign sites genuinely geoblock some Russian IPs for sanctions, security, commercial or political reasons.
Western platform moderation, sanctions and geoblocking must remain separate from attribution of Russian domestic network-level blocking.

next_gate.name: ACCOUNT_LEVEL_PHRASE_REUSE_GATE
requires: rare phrase or argument-order reuse across independent public posts
timing that is informative rather than simple post-news quotation
independent operator/infrastructure evidence before bot/state attribution

best_current_rhetoric_assessment: A recurring multi-year causal-attribution rhetoric is independently visible across Habr and Reddit: Russian users' loss of Western-platform access is repeatedly explained through reciprocal Western censorship, Google/platform self-blocking, Google infrastructure degradation, foreign platform exit, or bilateral digital isolation. A technically specific GGC causal template can be traced from legitimate industry risk into official attribution and then user-level repetition. The rhetoric/message lineage is confirmed; coordinated account operation or Russian state direction of the specific public accounts is not.
